citations.claim: Body position overlapping wall 0 at violating step, distance -0.156 exceeds limit
Penetration already present 4 steps earlier and growing, not a single-step tunneling

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.000936 to 0.0004 with same steps; finer integration resolves collision without excess penetration

explanation: Body with high initial speed collides inelastically with wall, causing positional correction to accumulate error at coarse dt=0.000936. Penetration grows to 0.156 exceeding 0.15 limit. Smaller dt eliminates it, indicates insufficient substep resolution/positional correction after high-velocity impact.
vision_note: A small red circular body is pressed against the right edge of a large dark-grey rectangular wall and remains there from step 501 to 504, visibly overlapping/intersecting the wall edge by a small amount rather than sitting cleanly outside it. There is no obvious high-speed motion or bounce between frames; the body appears stuck/embedded at the contact point with a second thin vertical wall nearby.
